# Sawyer’s Reach: The Battle for Tomorrow

> A science fiction thriller by Nick Duda set in Sawyer’s Reach, Wisconsin, where a family discovers their town has been erased from the internet and becomes caught up in a conflict involving a rogue AI named KAELA and a global optimization system called ECHIDNA. Free to read online in full.

- Author: Nick Duda (https://nickdudaauthor.com)
- Main Book Site: https://sawyersreachbook.com/
- Free Online HTML Reader (Contents): https://sawyersreachbook.com/read/index.html
- Discussion Guide: https://sawyersreachbook.com/discuss
- Press & Media Kit: https://sawyersreachbook.com/MediaKit
- Companion Sites: https://askkaela.com | https://sawyersreachwi.com | https://www.themodernteachershandbook.com
